doc: Memoire's declaration of which capture lane serves each fleet harness (liaison docs/design/HARNESS-PARITY.md § 2, B1: the harness inventory resolves agents and commands to harnesses; Memoire owns the decision whether a route has a verified native capture lane). Keys are the canonical harness ids of ~/.agents/harnesses.json. `native` is the lane for sessions run on the harness itself: `hooks` (hook scripts on the harness settings surface), `rollout-sweep` / `store-sweep` (a systemd user timer sweeping the harness's own session store, gated by an env flag in ~/.memoire/capture-tick.env), `extension` (a payload file copied onto the harness), or `none` with `applicable` — `false` when the harness has no native session at all (the route is n/a with the reason), `true` when native sessions exist but no reader does (a GAP, never n/a: an unimplemented applicable route stays red until implemented or covered by a filed upstream request). `acpx` names the lane for sessions driven through acpx: `boundaries` when the native lane already captures the turns (the journal adds prompt/result boundaries only), `journal` when the acpx journal is the only record (full capture). scripts/memoire-coverage.py validates every lane live and publishes ~/.agents/coverage/memoire.json; scripts/memoire-capture-acpx.sh derives boundaries-only mode from `acpx: boundaries` through the inventory's agent ownership — the former NATIVE_ADAPTERS shell list is gone.

native.doc: hook capture per prompt/tool plus the transcript tick (memoire-capture-claude-transcripts.sh)

qwen.acpx_doc: qwen-code has no acpx agent in the inventory; the lane is declared for completeness and is n/a while that holds

native.doc: the extension queues entries on agent_settled

sweep.doc: host-side sweep of Pi session files (agent sessions, the Conclave seat's store, caged workers' run directories) sharing the extension's cursor and keys; catches what the extension cannot see or reach

native.reason: Antigravity runs in the fleet only through acpx (isolated profile, no interactive CLI session store declared); the acpx journal is the record

native.doc: Muse Code session-store sweep (~/.local/share/muse/sessions, root and subagent session.jsonl) decoded through `muse export`; capture-all plus turn projection; verified live 2026-10-17 (first tick 21:32 CEST, 19 units, 2867 events, 0 failed)

acpx_lane.doc: The acpx journal adapter is run by memoire-capture-acpx-tick.timer (installed by scripts/capture-acpx-tick-timer.sh install, gated by MEMOIRE_CAPTURE_ACPX=on in ~/.memoire/capture-tick.env). Before 2026-10-15 the lane advanced only when run by hand.
